name: bq-warehouses-hde
description: Analyse 2026 BES customs warehouses and trade-and-services warehouses (HDE). Use for operator permits, approved premises/goods, stock control, handling, transfers, admission conditions, withdrawal and selected tax connections. Separates storage from release, HDE admission from company residence, and ABB zero rates from exemptions. Includes primary law, delegated controls, authority guidance and fictional boundary cases. This source-cited draft holds actual permits, transitional admissions, mixed activities, disputed export references and complete tax bills. Load with the universal workflow base and BES companions; professional review remains required before reliance.
